compatibility.breaking_change_policy: Bump JSONL version for incompatible wire changes; bump capability version for any advertised contract change.
compatibility.additive_change_policy: Clients must ignore unknown capability fields and may opt into newly advertised methods, fields, events, and types.
compatibility.deprecation_policy: Advertise deprecations in capabilities before removal and keep deprecated names until the next incompatible SDK contract version.

invalid_json.description: A request line was not valid JSON.

invalid_request.description: A request envelope, id, method, or params shape was invalid.

busy.description: The service rejected a request while a stream was active.

unavailable.description: The requested method exists but is not available for the current runtime/session state.

sdk_error.description: The SDK rejected a valid request.

cancelled.description: An active SDK operation stream was cancelled.

engine_error.description: The model runtime rejected a request without a more specific code.

account_setup.description: Provider account setup or billing prevented the model request.

provider_capacity.description: Provider capacity or rate limiting prevented the model request.

missing_credentials.description: Provider credentials are missing for the selected model.

model_unavailable.description: The selected model is unavailable for the configured provider endpoint.

circuit_open.description: The model provider circuit breaker is open after recent failures.

internal_error.description: An unexpected server-side exception escaped the SDK layer.
